# 🔗 Website Intelligence Report — powered by Microlink

Turn **any URL** into a full company brief in one run: **metadata · logo · branded screenshot · SEO / performance insights · tech stack · clean Markdown · PDF archive**.

**💡 Use it to build rich context about a company or platform** — feed the Markdown, image, logo and technical data to an **LLM** to generate an in-depth company profile, power **personalized marketing email campaigns**, or arm **sales reps** with the screenshot, PDF and talking points for their outreach scripts.

**▶ To test:** press **Test workflow**. It analyzes the URL set in the **Config** node using the free `api.microlink.io` endpoint (no credentials needed). *PDF* and *Insights* may require a Microlink API key — those nodes continue on error, so a run never breaks.

Made by Microlink · https://microlink.io/screenshot

## 1 · Input

**Config** holds the URL to analyze (default: `microlink.io`).

**Swap the trigger for production:**

- **Form Trigger** → let anyone submit a URL
- **Schedule + Sheets** → batch-audit a list
- **Webhook** → call it from your app

## 2 · Microlink capabilities

Five operations run in sequence. Each one reads the URL from **Config** via `$('Config').item.json.url`.

- **Extract** — title, description, image, logo, author, publisher, language
- **Insights** — Lighthouse performance / SEO / accessibility scores + tech stack *(API key)*
- **Markdown** — clean, LLM-ready page content, ready to pipe into an AI node
- **PDF** — pixel-perfect archive of the page *(API key)*
- **Screenshot** — branded capture with dark browser frame and gradient overlay

💡 Add **Microlink API** credentials on any node to raise rate limits and unlock PDF + Insights.

## 3 · Consolidate

**Assemble Report** merges every Microlink output into one clean JSON record and attaches the screenshot + PDF as binaries.

Edit the field paths in the Code node to keep more or fewer Microlink fields.

## 4 · Deliver

*Both nodes below are disabled — enable the one you need.*

- **Google Sheets** → append the report as a row
- **Slack** → post a rich summary card

Add the node credentials and you have an automated URL-audit pipeline. **Notion**, **Airtable**, **Email** or an **AI Summary** node drop in just as easily.
